hero.headline: Built to print.
hero.lede: Precision welding and fabrication for automation, energy, industrial and agricultural work. Send us a print or a CAD file and we’ll come back with a quote and a lead time.

capabilities.title: What we
capabilities.lede: Welding and fabrication done to the drawing. Every job starts with your print and ends with a part that matches it — on the date we quoted.

items.name: Welding
items.blurb: Clean, consistent welds on structural and precision work — from a single piece to a production run.

items.name: Fabrication
items.blurb: Frames, weldments, brackets and assemblies cut, formed and built to your print.

items.name: Prototypes & R&D
items.blurb: One-offs and first articles turned around fast, with the fit and finish of a finished part.

items.name: Production Parts
items.blurb: Repeatable precision parts, quoted with a real lead time and delivered when we said.

work.title: Out of the
work.lede: Frames, welds and precision parts, photographed on the floor the day they were finished.

about.quote: Our mission is to create precise products that reflect the unique needs of our clients — maintaining an expectation of high quality while delivering timely results.

pillars.name: Precise
pillars.text: Products that reflect the unique needs of the client — built to the print, checked against the print.

pillars.name: High quality
pillars.text: An expectation of high quality on every piece, not just the ones somebody is going to look at closely.

pillars.name: Timely
pillars.text: We go above and beyond to deliver on time. The lead time we quote is the lead time you get.

industries.title: Built for the people who
industries.lede: Automation integrators, energy and industrial plants, ag operations and engineering teams — the same shop, the same standard.

items.name: Automation
items.blurb: Frames, guarding, mounts and fixtures for automated cells.

items.name: Energy
items.blurb: Oil and gas hardware built to spec and delivered on schedule.

items.name: Industrial
items.blurb: Plant and process work — weldments, brackets, structural repair.

items.name: Prototype
items.blurb: First articles and one-offs for teams who need a part in hand.

items.name: Agriculture
items.blurb: Implements, attachments and repairs that hold up in the field.

items.name: R&D
items.blurb: Iterative builds for engineers still figuring out the final design.

process.title: Print in.
process.lede: No forms to download, no phone tag. Attach the drawing, tell us when you need it, and you'll hear back with a price and a date.

steps.name: Send the print
steps.blurb: Attach a PDF drawing or a CAD file — STEP, DWG, DXF, SolidWorks — right on this page.

steps.name: Get a quote and a lead time
steps.blurb: We review the print and reply with a price and a delivery date, not a guess.

steps.name: We build to print
steps.blurb: Welding and fabrication to the drawing, checked against the drawing.

steps.name: Delivered on time
steps.blurb: The date we quoted is the date it ships. That is the whole reputation.

process.cta: Send a print for a quote
process.files: PDF, DWG, DXF, STEP, IGES, SolidWorks — up to 50 MB a file.

areas.title: The Blue Water region
areas.lede: Based in Port Huron. We quote and deliver across St. Clair, Sanilac, Lapeer and northern Macomb counties — and ship anywhere a print comes from.

quote.title: Send the print.
quote.lede: Attach a PDF drawing or a CAD file, tell us how many and when you need them, and we'll reply with a price and a lead time.

footer.blurb: Quality welding and fabrication in Port Huron, Michigan. Precision parts, built to print and delivered on time.
footer.region: Port Huron · St. Clair County · Michigan

serviceAreas.title: and everywhere a print comes from.
serviceAreas.lede: We’re a Port Huron shop. Most of our work is for customers across the Blue Water region, the Thumb and northern Macomb County — close enough to drop off a part or walk a job together. Farther than that, we ship.

more.title: If you can send a print,
more.lede: The towns above are where we drive most. Parts ship from Port Huron to anywhere; attach the drawing and tell us where it's going.
